title: Vegetable egg fried rice
summary: Vegetable egg fried rice is a chinese dinner built around medium eggs and basmati rice, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

ingredients.prepNote: beaten if the method says so

steps.instruction: Slice medium eggs and basmati rice before the pan is hot. Vegetable egg fried rice is a fast cook, so have the sauce measured too.
steps.tip: A crowded wok steams. Cook the protein in two batches if the pan looks full.

steps.instruction: If the dish includes a grain or noodles, start them now in salted water so they are ready when the stir-fry is.
Heat the oil until it shimmers and fry medium eggs until just cooked. Scoop it onto a plate.

Fry the garlic and ginger, add basmati rice and frozen peas, return medium eggs, and toss with the sauce for a minute. Taste Vegetable egg fried rice before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
